svg.text: A100 · TriMul · training · D128, bf16, L a multiple of 16, dropout row scale (one direction: H = 128, P = 2H = 256 planes; bidirectional: H = 256, P = 512)
W_g' = bf16(0.5 W_g diag γ), W_o' = bf16(0.5 W_o diag γ_o)
s = Σ_k W', b = 0.5 W β
# outgoing: X = a b^T ; incoming: X = a^T b
F3 · output LN + proj + gate, saving
# also: μ_o, r_o, μ_i, r_i and x_n
HBM (saved for the backward: a | b planes, X, LN statistics, x_n)
# the forward's folds, and for the backward:
Wdx = [W_in ; W_g] # unscaled rows, K1 order
W_o·γ_o and its row sums, W_g·γ
o = r_o (X W_o'^T) - r_o μ_o s_o + b_o ; s = sigmoid(x_n W_g^T)
d_upd = dy * ds ; d_o = d_upd * s ; d_g = d_upd * o * s (1 - s)
A_o = d_o r_o ; dX = LN_out backward of (A_o W_o')
G += A_o^T X^T # on chip at H = 128
# outgoing: dA = dX b ; db = dX^T a
# incoming: dA = b dX^T ; db = a dX
W · weight gradients (side stream, under B2)
dγ_o = Σ W_o (G - v_o) ; dβ_o = Σ W_o S_o
(g, p) = x_n W_in^T ; dp = dA s m ; dg = dA p s (1 - s) m
dW_in += x_n^T [dg | dp] # registers, whole launch
dz = LN_in backward(dx_n) + dy ; dγ, dβ partials
dWl,lg,r,rg = Σ_groups dW_in[row] # fixed order, K1 row order undone
# written in each parameter's strides and dtype
HBM (the dgp tiles of B3 stay in an L2 ring)
[H, L, L] bf16 x 2 4H L² B
dW_l, dW_lg, dW_r, dW_rg, dW_g, dW_o, dγ, dβ, dγ_o, dβ_o ≈ 0.2-0.4 MB
